title: New Green Card route proposed by Democrats for immigrants facing deportation in US: Who qualifies and what the bill says
summary_full: Even if Democrats manage to pass the bill, it would still need President Donald Trump's approval. The president has the power to veto legislation. Trump recently told CBS News' 60 Minutes that he would like to work with Democrats on immigration, although he  reiterated that his administration would maintain a strong enforcement policy and ruled out an agreement that amounted to amnesty
